description: Immutable POS loyalty points ledger — one INSERT-only row per points event (earn from a completed POS ticket, redemption against the reward catalog, manual admin adjustment). posRewardBalances is a materialized projection over this ledger, updated transactionally by the same SP that inserts a row here. Corrections are new ADJUSTMENT entries, never UPDATEs — a client's point history must always be traceable back to a specific ticket or redemption. Logically and structurally separate from the existing loan-behavior rewardTransactions table and from any arcade chip ledger: no FK, no shared endpoint, and no function anywhere converts between them.

fields.name: clientId
fields.description: Client this points event belongs to.

fields.name: txType
fields.description: Allowed values: EARN, REDEEM, ADJUSTMENT, EXPIRE. Lookup values live in database hints, not a separate field table.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: D = debit (balance down, e.g. REDEEM), C = credit (balance up, e.g. EARN), from the client's perspective.

fields.name: points
fields.description: Always positive; direction carries the sign/effect on balance.

fields.name: referenceType
fields.description: What produced this entry. Allowed values: ticket, redemption, manual.

fields.name: referenceId
fields.description: incomeId for EARN rows (referenceType=ticket), redemptionId for REDEEM rows (referenceType=redemption). NULL for manual ADJUSTMENT.

fields.name: balanceAfter
fields.description: Denormalized running balance immediately after this entry — makes client statements O(1).

fields.name: description
fields.description: Short human-readable memo shown in the client's points history.

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.

components.name: PosRewardLedgerListStep
components.description: IonList of ledger rows newest-first, filtered by companyId + optional clientId, optional txType. Rows show txType chip (EARN/REDEEM/ADJUSTMENT/EXPIRE), signed points, description, created_At, running balanceAfter.

endpoints.description: The ONLY path allowed to insert EARN rows. Takes { incomeId, companyId }. Server-side: reads the ticket's incomeDetails lines for incomeId, joins posRewardProductRates per productId (only isActive=true rows), computes SUM(pointsPerUnit * quantity) across all lines, inserts one EARN row (referenceType='ticket', referenceId=incomeId), and updates posRewardBalances in the same transaction. Idempotent per incomeId — mirror the idempotencyKey pattern used in prd_walletTransaction.json: calling this twice for the same ticket must not double-post points. Returns { pointsEarned, newBalance, transactionId }.

Manual admin points adjustment. Takes { companyId, clientId, points, description, createdByUserId }. points may be positive or negative; inserts one ADJUSTMENT row (referenceType='manual') and updates posRewardBalances transactionally. Returns { newBalance }.

hints: INSERT-only: the standard CRUD SP must implement action 1 (insert) and reads; action 2 (update) and action 3 (delete) must return an error — corrections are new ADJUSTMENT/REVERSAL inserts, never edits.
Indexes: (clientId, created_At DESC) for client statements; (referenceType, referenceId) for ticket/redemption reconciliation.

sp_posRewardTransactions_earnFromTicket must be idempotent per (companyId, incomeId) — add a UNIQUE constraint on (companyId, referenceType, referenceId) WHERE referenceType='ticket' so a retried call is a no-op, not a duplicate EARN row.

sp_posRewardTransactions_earnFromTicket and sp_posRewardTransactions_adjust must update posRewardBalances (balance, lifetimeEarned or lifetimeRedeemed, lastActivity) inside the same transaction as the ledger insert — never write the ledger and the balance in separate calls.
